study: COMP 765 — Multiple Class Descriptions for Long-Tail Road-Event Recognition
novel_intervention: Five separately encoded descriptions aggregated into one prototype per semantic class, versus one canonical description. Both arms freshly retrained.
prior_work_excluded: single original wording versus single deterministic-template wording
architecture: Standalone semantic crop PhraseHead: Linear(1024,512), normalized projected feature, cosine against frozen184x512 bank, exp(learned log_tau initialized2.3),184 learned biases
encoder: OpenGVLab/InternVideo2_CLIP_S@1f9fca1389fd883defc652634d95a21121c85a8c; paired frozen mobile CLIP text tower from same model.safetensors
visual_features: Existing full crop caches: 8 real frames, pad2,224px crops, keyframe spatial-token mean,1024 fp16. No regeneration or adaptation.
aggregation: float32 L2 each embedding, arithmetic mean, float32 L2 mean; K=1 identical path
special_output: Row0 agentness retains canonical single prototype in BOTH conditions; no background prototype.183 semantic rows each receive5 descriptions in multi.
text_encoding: Publisher tokenizer/context77 and TextTransformer forward/EOT pooling, eval, half weights plus fp16 CUDA autocast as original embed_phrases.py; no new prompt prefix beyond saved manifest

training.loss: mean focal gamma2 with existing flat_alphas.pt; all184 outputs
training.selection: final epoch10, no development or validation selection
training.initialization: manual_seed(seed) immediately before identical head construction; dedicated CPU batch generator with same seed; verify trainable state and order hashes per pair
training.feature_handling: Raw cached features cast float32; historical nan/inf to zero for training only; no feature L2 pre-normalization
training.resume: Atomic per100-step and epoch checkpoints with model, Adam, permutation, offset, RNG; verified byte-hash backups

evaluation.metric: Official detector frame AP at IoU0.5, unchanged published baseline AP core
evaluation.assembly: YOLO confidence for agentness, YOLO class-specific confidence for agents, sigmoid learned outputs times YOLO confidence for action/loc/duplex/triplet; no new threshold/NMS
evaluation.historical_difference: Uses corrected shared36717 manifest including empty train_00653_00042; older crop-full scripts reported36716. Same as controlled repeated-seed study; no silent frame dropping.

primary: Paired multi-minus-single detector Tail47 triplet mAP in percentage points
tail_definition: Authoritative proposal-tail/train-counts.json: standardize log10 box counts across86 training triplets using population std; Tail47 z<0, Deep28 z<-.5, Common39 z>=0. Verify stored membership; never validation frequencies.
analysis: Per-seed values; mean/sample SD ddof1 by arm; paired deltas/mean/SD and95% paired-t CI df2 (t=4.3026527297); all class differences and improved/declined/tied counts using sign of mean paired delta; primary uncertainty across training seeds only
freeze: Hash protocol, descriptions, prototypes, code and source assets before primary runs; no wording/seed/hyperparameter tuning against validation AP
geometry: Before training save norms, cosine matrices, canonical-to-aggregate cosine, exact/near duplicates threshold.999, token lengths and truncation/token-identity checks; explanatory only
limitations: Three seeds provide weak uncertainty estimates and do not sample new datasets
Prototype geometry changes along with wording; linguistic semantics not isolated
Practical five-description intervention does not separate averaging benefit from added wording quality
Existing canonical phrases contain inherited imprecisions; retained exactly and documented in manifest
storage: Code under new COMP765 directory only; outputs under /home/brandon/.local/share/road-reason/comp765-multiple-descriptions-20261021; no thesis/result overwrites, no new visual caches, detector scores in RAM
launch_gate: novelty review, asset audit, prototype/token tests, initialization/count/score parity, exact resume test, benchmark and ETA, silent persistent monitor
